name: freecc
description: FREECC — a free Claude-Code-class agent stack: quota-pooled free-LLM router, harness wiring, quality-gated cascade and mechanical gates, plus a zero-dependency interactive UI for decomposition and verification.

paragraphs: A routing + harness + verification stack that runs coding agents on free model quotas (Gemini / Groq / OpenRouter / local Ollama, with near-free DeepSeek as the never-stall anchor) and reaches Claude-Code-Max-class effective performance through the mechanisms that are scientifically and empirically proven to substitute for a bigger model and a bigger wallet:
Everything claimed here is backed by EVIDENCE.md (ledger E1–E19) and executed by gates/run-gates.sh (17/17 PASS in this workspace — see REPORT.md).

Setting this up for the first time? Follow SETUP.md — a numbered walkthrough from an empty machine to a working free-LLM stack: every tool, every provider key, and the model-ID verification step that most setups get wrong.
features: FrugalGPT cascade — pay for strength only when verification proves weakness ([E6])
RouteLLM-style routing — cheap-first with escalation keeps 95%+ quality at a fraction of cost ([E7])
mikoshi-construct ladder — low→low→medium→high reasoning budget, harness verdicts never self-reported (E1)
Externalized memory — 10 discovery markers instead of a huge context window (E3)
Quota pooling with failover — because free tiers shrink and 429, the pool IS the limit ([E11]–[E13])
